subject: Error messages for semTools standardized summary

messages.author: 7922d8827f75b337
messages.subject: Error messages for semTools standardized summary
parts:
When I run semTools auxiliary() summary I get results. However, when I ask for standardized loadings, [summary(aux.fit, standardized = TRUE)] I get these error messages: 

Error: evaluation nested too deeply: infinite recursion / options(expressions=)?
Error during wrapup: evaluation nested too deeply: infinite recursion / options(expressions=)?

Why?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Error messages for semTools standardized summary
parts:
Why?

I've never seen that error message before.  But if you are using the latest version of semTools (0.4-15.905, not yet on CRAN), the auxiliary() function just returns a regular lavaan object with the additional auxiliary parameters estimated, so I don't see why there would be a problem getting standardized results.  Do you also get the error when you use the standardizedSolution() function?  

Note that the latest development version of semTools also requires the development version of lavaan:

install.packages("lavaan", repos = "http://www.da.ugent.be", type = "source")
# if necessary:    install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("simsem/semTools/semTools")

It might also help to post your full R script, and maybe enough data to reproduce the problem, along with your sessionInfo() output.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
UvA web page: http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen

summary(test.cfa.fit.aux) # Works fine

summary(test.cfa.fit.aux, standardized=TRUE) # Get error
